def: a native of the same town, i.e. (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-Christian)

occurrences.text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
